reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E1 shows V and Cr form second-phase precipitates and segregate to grain boundaries in a different alloy, contradicting the premise of single-phase BCC stability. E2 only discusses grain size effects on ductility in NbMoTaW, not V addition. No evidence is provided for V-induced lattice distortions, enhanced defect sinks, or high-temperature strength retention.
premises: V addition induces local lattice distortions and modified short-range order in BCC NbMoTaW
